title: Admin Katha Direct Publish with TTS, Instant Community Photos, and Performance Improvements

requirements.text: When an admin adds a new Katha from the Admin Panel, it must be saved to the backend and immediately appear in the Kathayen section without requiring any extra approval step or manual publishing action.

quotes: Admin panel me jo bhi katha admin add kre vo seedha katha section me add ho
Admin Panel से कथा add करने पर सीधे Katha Section में दिखे

acceptanceCriteria: Admin submits a new Katha via the Admin Panel form.
The Katha is stored in the backend with an approved/published status by default.
The Katha immediately appears in the Kathayen listing page without requiring any additional approval toggle.
The newly added Katha card is visible to all users on the Kathayen page.

requirements.text: Every Katha detail page must include an automatic Text-to-Speech (TTS) narration option. When a Katha is added via the Admin Panel, the TTS narration control must be present on its detail page without any additional configuration required.

quotes: apne aap usme narration option add ho jaye
tts ka option apne aap add ho or admin jo katha add kre
हर कथा में automatically TTS (Text-to-Speech) narration option add हो जाए

acceptanceCriteria: KathaDetail page renders TTS play/pause/stop controls for every katha, including those added dynamically from the backend.
TTS uses Hindi voice when available (matching existing useSpeechNarration hook behavior).
TTS controls are visible without any manual toggle or extra admin step.
Static kathas from kathaData.ts also have TTS controls if not already present.

requirements.text: Community posts containing images must appear instantly after upload without any approval delay. Remove or bypass any approval queue or pending state for image/media posts so that uploaded photos are visible to the uploader and other users immediately.

quotes: community me jo bhi pic vagara upload krta hun to kam se kam 1 ghanta lagta hai dekhne ke liya
Community mein upload ki gayi photos turant dikhen bina kisi delay ke

acceptanceCriteria: A community post with an image attachment is visible in the Community feed immediately after submission.
No approval step is required for community posts with image/video attachments.
The post appears in the feed within seconds of submission, not minutes or hours.

requirements.text: Improve overall app performance and smoothness: reduce unnecessary re-renders, optimize React Query cache settings (stale time, cache time), and ensure list pages (Kathayen, Community) load quickly with minimal layout shift.

quotes: App ki overall performance aur smoothness improve karna

acceptanceCriteria: React Query staleTime is set to a reasonable value (e.g., 30 seconds) to avoid redundant refetches on navigation.
Kathayen and Community pages do not flicker or show empty states during data load when data is already cached.
Community post submission does not freeze or lag the UI.
No obvious janky scroll or animation issues on Home, Kathayen, and Community pages.

constraints: Do not alter immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
All backend logic must remain in the single-actor backend/main.mo file.
Preserve existing Internet Identity authentication flow.
Do not remove or break any existing sections (Aarti, Jap, Mandir, AIGuru, Panchang, etc.).
nonGoals: Adding audio file upload for katha narration (TTS only, not recorded audio).
Implementing a moderation/approval workflow for kathas.
Changing the overall app design or color theme.
Adding new sections or features beyond those listed in requirements.
